summary: American Healthcare REIT filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose a routine quarterly distribution authorized by its board of directors. The filing announces a cash dividend of $0.25 per share for the quarter ending June 30, 2026, representing an annualized rate of $1.00 per share. The distribution is payable on July 17, 2026 to holders of record as of June 30, 2026, from legally available funds. No special situation such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. This is a standard dividend declaration with no extraordinary corporate event, deal terms, or risk-arb angle to monitor.
